values.note: 28 sites on ReserveAmerica: 15 in Cains Coulee (35-70 ft, five pull-through at 45-65 ft), 6 in Pine On Rocks (20-25 ft), 3 Upper Campsites, a double, a backcountry site and 2 rustic Valley View sites. No electric sites are sold.

note: MT State Park (badlands) at Glendive. Developed campground (Cains Coulee) sits near the visitor center just inside the entrance; drive-in back-in/pull-through sites capable of large RVs. Note RVs over 20 ft are restricted to the first ~2 miles and NOT allowed past the switchbacks — the developed campground is within that big-rig-allowed zone. --Claude
summary: FWP page + ReserveAmerica: confirmed year-round campground, vault toilets, pull-throughs, reservable on ReserveAmerica (derived values now verified) with the inherited 3-month window and 1-day cutoff; added 28 sites, 70-ft max (Cains Coulee), flush toilets and year-round water. Fees left as recorded (FWP gives only the $4-$34 range). Not stated: dump station (derived none left), fcfs (derived some_sites left), the RV-over-20-ft road restriction, 7-night limit (inherited).
